description: This file defines the 'Variant' type and associated functions for handling D-Bus variant types, including parsing, formatting, and conversion utilities.

classes.name: Variant
classes.description: Represents a D-Bus variant type with methods for parsing, formatting, and conversion.

methods.name: MakeVariant
methods.description: Converts a value to a Variant, inferring its signature.

methods.name: MakeVariantWithSignature
methods.description: Converts a value to a Variant with a specified signature.

methods.name: ParseVariant
methods.description: Parses a string into a Variant, optionally with an expected signature.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representation of the Variant's value and whether it can be unambiguously parsed.

methods.name: Signature
methods.description: Returns the D-Bus signature of the Variant.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the Variant's value.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Returns the underlying value of the Variant.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Converts the Variant into a native Go type.
